findings.suggested_change: Limitation of Liability. Except for breaches or violations of Article 9, indemnity liabilities arising under Article 8, or cases of gross negligence or willful misconduct, each Party’s total liability to the other shall not exceed the total fees paid under this Agreement.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Dear [Client],

I hope you are well. Before I sign the agreement, I would like to suggest a small amendment to ensure the liability terms are balanced:

- The agreement currently limits certain types of damages but does not set an overall cap on my direct liability. I propose that the relevant clause be revised so that each party’s total liability to the other shall not exceed the total fees paid under this Agreement, except for breaches of Article 9, indemnity liabilities under Article 8, or gross negligence or willful misconduct.

Thank you for considering these changes. I look forward to moving ahead.

Best regards,
